name: Kakuda (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kakuda city emblem in white: a disc bearing a green stylised leaf, with a point at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Kakuda, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1959.

features.role: Kakuda city emblem — a disc bearing a green stylised leaf, with a point at the top
